entry.title: How UNFI tackles higher fuel prices

entry.summary: Fighting the memory supply crisis is front and center, pushing companies to refine planning practices and rethink product mix and logistics tactics, experts say.

entry.title: Lego taps e-methanol to make certain products, cut reliance on fossil fuels
entry.summary: The Danish toymaker said it has started using low-carbon fuel to produce over 90 components like steering wheels, connectors and Minifigure hands to reduce its dependency on virgin fossil fuel.

entry.title: FedEx, UPS delivery prices set for record-high Q4
